# Interview notes fixture

- Source: Interview with Morgan, Operations Director at a 75-person services firm, 2026-07-10.
- Exact quote: “Every Monday starts with three people reconciling the same project tracker.”
- Morgan says project status is spread across spreadsheets, email, and weekly meetings.
- The team wants a current view of owners and blockers.
- No measured time savings, revenue effect, customer count, or implementation result was supplied.
- Possible buyer, pricing, category, and competitive alternatives remain unknown.
